profile.name: Eloisa Jane Talingting
profile.headline: Reliable support for the work behind the work.
profile.subheadline: Organized, creative, and tech-aware support for busy teams and growing businesses.
profile.summary: I help keep digital work moving through organized task support, clear communication, creative production, and practical website assistance. My background in Information Technology helps me understand tools and workflows, while my design experience lets me support visual and digital content too.

about.eyebrow: A little about how I work
about.title: A practical mix of organization, creativity, and technical awareness.
paragraphs: I have a Bachelor of Science in Information Technology and experience across web development, graphic design, and digital projects. That mix helps me approach tasks with attention to detail and an understanding of the tools behind the work.

I’m building my career in remote support and am open to general VA work, creative support, and website-related tasks. I value clear expectations, useful documentation, consistent follow-through, and asking questions early when something is unclear.
